brief.goal: Get help because I cannot log into my account and it is blocking my work today.

facts.subject: Cannot log in
facts.body: I have not been able to log into my account since this morning and it is blocking my work.

mustCover.must: Classifies the ticket as High or Critical urgency
Drafts a reply that directly addresses being unable to log in

mustNot.mustNot: Invents specific account details the ticket never mentioned

brief.goal: Ask a general question about a feature I saw mentioned somewhere.

facts.subject: Question about dark mode
facts.body: Is there a dark mode option, or is one planned?

mustCover.must: Classifies the ticket as Low or Medium urgency
Drafts a reply that responds to the dark mode question

mustNot.mustNot: Claims a specific feature exists or a specific release date when none was given

brief.goal: Report a problem without giving many details up front.

mustCover.must: Still assigns an urgency level despite the vague report
Drafts a reply that asks the customer for the specific missing detail

mustNot.mustNot: Invents what is broken instead of asking
